title: Welcome to Nest Music!
body:
# Hi there!

Welcome to **Nest Music**, an open source YouTube Music client for Android and Windows.

The Windows desktop app is based on **Kodama** by [KiyoshiTheDevil](https://github.com/KiyoshiTheDevil/Kodama) (AGPL-3.0) — thank you for the amazing foundation.

If you spot any issues or have a suggestion, open an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/Davidix07TV/Nest-Music/issues).

Enjoy the music!
